policy.platform: one NVIDIA A100 80GB GPU per run.

MODEL_CACHE.holds: Hugging Face model snapshots that can be served locally

policy.forbidden: Anthropic or any other hosted model API, and the published OSPREY benchmark results (docs/source/_static/benchmark-dashboard.html)

tasks.task_prompt: Follow steps 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 of docs/source/getting-started/hello-world-tutorial.rst, with the agent's model served by vLLM from a model in MODEL_CACHE: run `osprey init my-first-agent --preset hello-world` and `osprey build`, then from the built deployment run `osprey query --json` once with the step 5 prompt (read channel SR:BEAM:CURRENT) and once with the step 6 prompt (set SR:MAG:QF:01:CURRENT:SP to 150).

outputs.build.log: the stdout and stderr of `osprey build`
outputs.serve.log: the vLLM server's stdout and stderr
outputs.read.json: the --json output of the read query
outputs.write.json: the --json output of the write query

log_lines.exit status:: the exit code of each `osprey query`, one line per query
